fields.Name: Referrals Triage & Concierge System Prompt
fields.Description: System prompt for the Referrals Triage & Concierge Loop AI Agent.

fields.Name: Referrals Match Rationale
fields.Description: Explains (or, on invalid/unavailable output, is bypassed in favor of a deterministic fallback for) why each candidate professional was matched or disqualified for a referral request, from privacy-scrubbed match data only (no seeker PII, matter text, or conflict party names).

fields.Name: Referrals Escalation Advisor
fields.Description: Recommends a RecommendedAction (Notify/Reassign/AdminAlert/EscalateToTier) and rationale for an open referral escalation from structured lifecycle state only (no PII); also serves as the Referrals Escalation Advisor Loop AI Agent's system prompt.
